nodeSlice: P1-N12 observed daily coverage and published evidence UI
outcome: The administrator data-quality route is ready and navigable under its existing operations:read permission, with independent daily-coverage and published-evidence regions.
Date, supported source, canonical security code and evidence status filters validate input; re-query and reset reload results and discard prior evidence pagination and snapshot selection.
Returned groups, the latest returned date and relatively older dates are explicitly local to the response. Missing-day judgment remains unknown without an expected trading-calendar basis.
The existing sanitized evidence volume is restored as an API-only read-only mount; no raw mount, exporter or collection task is added.

verification.tdd: Initial page/filter/coverage/route tests failed before implementation. The three review regressions then failed for future logical dates in coverage and details and missing busy-button semantics; they passed after the focused fixes.

webTargetedTests.scope: 10 affected page, filter, coverage parser/panel, date-detail parser/panel/hook, evidence parser/panel and route-contract test files
webTargetedTests.result: 49 tests passed after all review fixes

composeTests.result: The new sanitized-mount assertion first failed; all 7 configured checks passed after restoring the read-only mount.

versionTests.result: The 1.0.6 expectation first failed against 1.0.5; both tests passed after the version update.

verification.staticChecks: Web typecheck and the 16 related Web-file ESLint/Prettier checks passed. Parent-owned script/version lint, selected package/configuration/document formatting and diff checks passed.

build.command: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.apps.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.v1.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env build server web
build.result: One shared Node Docker build passed for Web and server, including TypeScript and Vite. No local aggregate repository suite was run.

realReads.environment: Read-only existing service/read-model calls against local storage, followed by the final client parsers; this is not authenticated HTTP or browser acceptance.

publicEvidence.meaning: Existing historical collection evidence, not proof that current daily collection is healthy.

passed: 58 observed dates expand and paginate from page 1 to page 2.
An invalid prefix code displays an accessible error without increasing API request counts.
A trimmed lowercase suffix code queries the canonical sample; keyboard Enter works and repeating the same query increases both query counts.
Reset clears the prior selection; a published FILTERED record expands with its original period, dates, reason and record counts.
All four label-to-control gaps measure 8px. At a 390px viewport the page width is 375px and both tables scroll inside 327px containers.

With controlled API delay the query button is natively disabled, aria-busy=true and computed cursor=progress. The date field uses a text cursor, and dark color-scheme makes its native calendar indicator readable.
browser.cleanup: Owned temporary HTML removed, both temporary processes stopped, responsive override reset and isolated tab closed; screenshot retained in ignored local work.
browser.isolatedEnvironment: A temporary loopback-only API served a captured real public sample and published evidence to the actual DataQualityPage. An explicit isolated-check banner limited the meaning of the sample filters.

authenticatedAcceptance.environment: Existing local application and storage, using its normal browser login flow; no API fixtures.
passed: The actual default coverage response displays 100 groups, truncation and unknown missing-day judgment.
Filtering 600519.SH / akshare-tencent shows 58 observed days through Oct 22; actual date detail pagination reaches page 2 of 2.
Filtering the actual published Sina evidence opens a FILTERED record with original MINUTE_1 period, dates, reason and 1732 filtered rows.
The unchanged 1.0.5 comparison also passed historical sorting, keyboard and instrument-detail navigation in this runtime.
authenticatedAcceptance.screenshot: Actual page screenshot retained locally; only main content and a pre-existing public sample are shown.

verification.independentReview: One independent final-code review found three issues: logical-date cutoff in coverage/details, busy-query semantics and native date-control styling. The original implementer fixed them with regressions; a finding-closure check confirmed all three closed with no new blocker.

runtime.health: GET /api/v1/health: status ok, version 1.0.6; Web and server containers healthy
runtime.evidenceMount: The actual API container has read-only public-status and public-quality mounts, with no raw mount; its UID 1000 reads the 14-record public list and detail.
runtime.preserved: Existing databases and collection workers were not recreated or migrated.

reusedEvidence: 2026-10-17-v1.0.4-local-acceptance.json: unchanged authentication, personal-watchlist persistence, collection and restart behavior.

2026-10-23-v1.0.5-local-acceptance.json: prior comparison source/build/CI evidence reused because the relevant implementation is unchanged; its actual logged-in walk is now complete and the slice is delivered in 1.0.6.
limits: Observed groups and date counts are not full-market completeness or expected trading-day checks. Truncated responses describe only the returned groups.
The coverage and detail client boundaries reject future logical dates. Existing backend aggregate SQL is unchanged and still relies on producer integrity for direct API consumers.
Historical public evidence retains its original period and publication time. This version does not enable a new exporter or claim current daily-source exception coverage.
Actual logged-in browser acceptance is complete and v1.0.6 is registered. No production deployment, complete P1-N12 or Phase 1 exit is claimed.
No new API/schema, dependency, credential, data source, fund-quality entry, broker or real-order capability.

git.releaseReceiptNote: This is the sole incremental receipt. Documentation-only changes do not invalidate the verified application build or unchanged-code checks.
